answer: A ripple ring reputation system expands concentric trust rings outward from each verified identity. Ring 0 is the origin node with full weight; ring 1 peers carry 0.5x weight; ring 2 peers carry 0.25x. A grove dendrological proof requires each identity to show growth rings: one attested milestone per 10 epochs, minimum 5 rings to qualify. Clones cannot fabricate rings retroactively. An umber shadow pool forces every new identity to lock B=200 credits in a separate settlement pool for 70 epochs, cost C(n)=B*2^n. Any duplicate ring pattern across identities forfeits all umber pools.
